landing.heroTitle: From fiber to fit, in one studio.
landing.heroBody: Sketch garments with real fabrics, read their engineering, and see them move on a body — before a single metre is cut.
landing.trustedBy: Built for designers, engineers, students and brands across 40+ countries

studio.title: Design Studio
studio.body: Garment templates, real fabrics, prints, layers and an automatic tech pack with fabric consumption.

fabrics.title: Fabric Library
fabrics.body: Engineering-grade specs — GSM, weave, stretch, drape, shrinkage, sustainability — and side-by-side compare.

tryon.title: Virtual Try-On
tryon.body: 3D avatars from your measurements, fabric-aware drape and a fit heatmap with size recommendation.

academy.title: Textile Academy
academy.body: Courses on fibers, weaving, dyeing and testing, plus calculators engineers actually use.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.body: Verified mills and manufacturers. Request swatches, quotes and talk directly.

community.title: Community
community.body: Portfolios, monthly challenges and a Virtual Fashion Week gallery.

landing.techBody: Fabrics aren't pictures here. Each one carries fiber composition, weight, construction, stretch and drape, and those numbers drive the tech pack, the fabric estimate and how the cloth falls on the avatar.
landing.pricingTitle: Start free. Scale when you sell.
landing.apiBody: Embed the NASEEJ fit engine in your Shopify or WooCommerce store. Shoppers see the fit before they buy.

testimonials.quote: I finally understand why my crepe dress hangs differently from the sample. Seeing the drape on the avatar saved me two rounds of toiles.
testimonials.name: Layla Haddad

testimonials.quote: The consumption estimate lands within 4% of our marker room. For costing on day one, that's all we need.
testimonials.name: Tomás Ferreira

testimonials.quote: My students use the yarn-count converter and the weave lessons every week. It feels like a lab in the browser.
testimonials.name: Dr. Amina Yusuf

landing.ctaTitle: Your next collection starts with a thread.
landing.ctaBody: Free for students. No card required.

fabrics.title: Materials, with the engineering attached.
fabrics.subtitle: Filter by fiber, weight, construction or season. Pick up to four to compare side by side.
fabrics.compareMax: You can compare up to 4 fabrics
fabrics.compareEmpty: Add fabrics to compare from the library.

studio.title: Design Studio
studio.selectPiece: Select a piece on the canvas or in the layers panel.
studio.consumptionNote: Estimate at {{width}} cm usable width incl. shrinkage, one-way layout, pattern repeat and 5% cutting loss.

tryon.title: Virtual Try-On
tryon.subtitle: See how fabric and fit behave on a body before you cut.
tryon.recommendedBody: Based on your measurements and the fabric's stretch.
tryon.dragHint: Drag to rotate · scroll to zoom

photo.title: Photo Try-On
photo.body: Upload a full-body photo, choose a garment and the AI provider renders it on you.
photo.mockNote: Demo provider: a stylised overlay stands in until a try-on AI provider is configured.
photo.privacy: Photos are processed in your browser by the demo provider and never uploaded.

ar.title: AR Mirror
ar.body: A live webcam view with the garment tracked to your pose (MediaPipe).
ar.denied: Camera access was denied or is unavailable.
ar.note: Pose tracking ships in the next release. The camera preview works today.
